Statement sets on Kakatiya architecture: Jain phase, Chalukyan influence, Thousand Pillar trikuta (Rudreshwara, Vasudeva, Surya).
App adds engineering (sandbox, floating bricks), Warangal fort layers and the Kala Thoranam emblem - sound, AP/Telangana-heavy and deeper than PYQs; a few imported ap-history items are off-topic.
